highlights_headline: This development build improves how SkiaSharp API documentation is authored, packaged, and delivered to consumers.
highlights_body: Compiler-generated XML documentation now accompanies packages, while generated bindings and HarfBuzz metadata stay aligned with their native sources.

bullets.lead: Package documentation is delivered from source comments
bullets.detail: API documentation is authored alongside the C# APIs and included as compiler XML sidecars, making the package documentation available directly to IDE consumers.
Generated P/Invoke and HarfBuzz binding metadata are organized per type and derived from the native sources used to build the packages.
